description: Stellar Minds is a team of young, curious, and creative individuals who share an interest in space, science, and technology. We enjoy exploring new ideas, learning together, and using our skills to create meaningful projects. Through NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to combine creativity, research, and technology to make space exploration more accessible and interesting to everyone.
summary:
Cosmic Legacy is an educational website created by Team Stellar Minds for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It is about the machines, robots, and rovers that were left behind on the Moon and Mars after their missions ended.

We developed an interactive website where people can discover the stories of these machines, learn about their missions, explore their locations on maps, read interesting facts, take quizzes, and play educational games.

Our project is connected to the challenge “Abandoned, But Not Forgotten” because it gives attention to machines that are often forgotten after their missions are over.

Cosmic Legacy is made for everyone, especially children and young people who are interested in space. We want to show that these machines are not just old equipment. They are an important part of space history, and their discoveries still matter today.
details:
Our project, Cosmic Legacy, is an interactive website that helps people learn about machines left behind on the Moon and Mars. Visitors can explore different missions, read stories about rovers, discover their locations on interactive maps, take quizzes, and play a memory game. The website makes space history easier and more interesting to understand.

We created this project to help people, especially young students, learn about space exploration in a fun way. We want visitors to understand that these machines are still important, even after their missions have ended.

We used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build the website, and Visual Studio Code as our main code editor. Our creative idea was to combine education with games, maps, and interesting facts in one place. During development, we considered simple navigation, attractive design, mobile devices, and easy-to-understand information. Our main goal was to make learning about forgotten space machines enjoyable and meaningful for everyone.
